source: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform, Terna public API
description: Balancing data of bidding zone CSUD ('ZONE|series'; 'NORD|'/'SUD|' imbalance volume = macrozone, FCR and aFRR requirement = Terna area). Prices EUR/MWh (FCR EUR/MW), volumes MW; hourly = average of the quarter-hours (activation prices weighted by the energy activated), daily = average for prices and capacities, sum of the hours (MWh/day) for energy. Italian market time, labelled by elapsed time since local midnight.
